scope.selection: Exactly the 66 prior coverage.uncurated_refs; FY2024 annual report and April 2025 CEO letter only.
scope.review_basis: Read full saved extraction quotations, verified all 66 as exact substrings of their saved physical pages; consulted full pages for ambiguous scope, referents, dates and unsupported summaries. Offline automated proposal; no human sign-off or delivery verdicts.
scope.date_policy: Container publication and fiscal period are not statement dates. Null means unsupported or unreviewed. Human-readable future windows are proposals, not normalized deadlines or completed events.
scope.attribution_policy: Company outcomes remain company outcomes. No individual attribution or collective board choice is inferred from a financial result.
scope.compound_record_policy: Each claim is assigned exactly once. Mixed deliverables/metrics within a source record remain explicitly flagged review bundles and require separate normalized entries before ledger matching.
scope.immutability: Original evidence, existing v1 entries and raw summaries are unchanged; this file is a separate proposed inventory.
